diagnosis: Default deck construction inserted all Momentum variants twice before truncating to 55 pages, producing decks with 55 Momentum pages and no attacks.
Momentum pages immediately drew back to five, allowing an endless Momentum replacement loop.
Random CPU opening hands could contain no legal offensive Standing/Any move, causing permanent hand locks.
fixes: Balanced 55-page default decks with 15 basic Momentum pages and 40 offensive/support pages.
Momentum pages no longer automatically refill the hand.
Default opening hands guarantee at least one basic Momentum page and one legal zero/one-cost Standing/Any attack.
Previously saved momentum-only custom decks are automatically repaired.

tests.deckComposition: 10 roster defaults checked; each includes attacks and Momentum
tests.openingHand: guaranteed starter move and Momentum for generated CPU/default hands
